sources.title: Piracy monthly report January 2025
sources.text: While at anchor, a crew member spotted two perpetrators on port side main deck near accommodation area. The crew member immediately alerted the bridge of the incident and general alarm was sounded. The two perpetrators immediately jumped onto a boat waiting along the ship. Ropes with hook were used to board the ship. A search was conducted onboard. The crew was not injured. Some unsecured items onboard were stolen. The incident was reported to Belawan VTS.
